{{Top|leg}}
'''Truth For Cularin''', or '''TFC''', was an organization that was active in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They produced a number of [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] documentaries about the various problems that the system faced and included a lot of unfounded speculation about what had caused the problems. In one such documentary, [[Jarik Vuintor]], a member of TFC, clain the [[Believers]] posed a great threat to the system, and that they were being funded by both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]].
